title: I've Been Working On An Air Combat Sandbox
author: burnoutmonk
selftext:
Hello,  
  
I've been trying to get something together to test different aircraft and SAMs against each other. Right now, I have the aircraft part kind of working. I've tried to keep the physics as realistic as possible without rolling any dice.  
  
Right now you can set up fights with 9 jets (F-15C, F-16C, F-35A, Typhoon, Su-27SK, Su-30SM, Su-35S, MiG-31BM, J-16), up to 8v8, pick loadouts and start positions, and watch the AI fight it out.   
  
[It's free and current version](https://burnoutgames.itch.io/airspace-command-demo) will stay free on [itch.io](http://itch.io) so welcome to try out your battle ideas.
